name: hot_loop
comment: Tutorial: two named hot loops, ~50/50 split. W1 sanity check.

name: alloc_thrash
comment: Tutorial: alloc_thrash_loop dominates flat_loop on cycles due to malloc churn. Exercises cache-pressure path when --memory-pressure is enabled.

name: string_parse
comment: Tutorial: two parser hot functions; also exposes a libc leaf (isspace) in the hot path.

name: branch_miss
comment: Tutorial: random_branch dominates sorted_branch due to branch-predictor misses. Clean baseline — should NOT trigger MemoryPressure.
